about_blocks.text: Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery
about_blocks.html: Unique Therapies at Prairie Sky Recovery

about_blocks.text: At Prairie Sky Recovery, they use a variety of unique and innovative therapies to help their clients overcome addiction. In addition to the traditional 12-Step program, they offer a range of evidence-based treatments like dialectical behavior therapy, motivational interviewing, and cognitive behavior therapy. They also offer mindfulness, communication, and assertiveness training, along with financial literacy programs. These therapies are designed to help clients address the root causes of their addiction and develop the skills they need to live a healthy and fulfilling life in recovery.

about_blocks.text: Another unique aspect of Prairie Sky Recovery is their use of equine therapy. Horses can be incredibly therapeutic, helping individuals to build trust, improve their communication skills, and develop a sense of responsibility. At Prairie Sky Recovery, clients can participate in horse therapy sessions, guided by experienced professionals who understand the power of this unique treatment.

about_blocks.html: The Benefits of Whole Person Recovery at Prairie Sky

about_blocks.text: Prairie Sky Recovery takes a whole-person approach to addiction treatment, addressing every aspect of a client’s physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health. This holistic approach recognizes that addiction is a complex disease that requires a multi-faceted treatment approach.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prairie Sky Recovery

faqs.question: Will I be required to participate in the 12-Step program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, the 12-Step program is part of our overall treatment approach at Prairie Sky Recovery, but we offer a range of other evidence-based therapies as well.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, the 12-Step program is part of our overall treatment approach at Prairie Sky Recovery, but we offer a range of other evidence-based therapies as well.

faqs.question: Can my family participate in my treatment at Prairie Sky Recovery?

answer_blocks.text: Yes, we offer a 2-day psychoeducation program for families of clients to participate in.
answer_blocks.html: Yes, we offer a 2-day psychoeducation program for families of clients to participate in.

faqs.question: How long is the program at Prairie Sky Recovery?

answer_blocks.text: Our programs range from 42 to 90 days, depending on the needs of each individual client.
answer_blocks.html: Our programs range from 42 to 90 days, depending on the needs of each individual client.

faqs.question: What types of addiction does Prairie Sky Recovery treat?

answer_blocks.text: We treat all kinds of addiction, including substance abuse, alcohol addiction, and non-substance addictions such as gambling and food addiction.
answer_blocks.html: We treat all kinds of addiction, including substance abuse, alcohol addiction, and non-substance addictions such as gambling and food addiction.

faqs.question: Can I bring my pet to Prairie Sky Recovery?

answer_blocks.text: No, we cannot allow pets at our facility due to the potential for disruption to other clients and staff.
